Wyoming sagebrush (Artemesia tridentata var. wyomensis) makes up ninety-nine percent (99%) of the biomass with squirreltail grass (Sitanion hystrix), Indian ricegrass (Orozopsis hymenoides), stickseed (Cryptantha spp.), halogeton (Halogeton glomeratus) and cheatgrass (Bromus tectorum) making up the remaining one percent (1%).
